description: This file declares functions and macros related to managing Git repositories in the libgit2 library, including creation, cleanup, configuration, and setting various repository components.

methods.name: git_repository_new
methods.description: Creates a new, empty Git repository object, optionally without backends or config.

methods.name: git_repository__cleanup
methods.description: Frees internal memory and resets the repository to a blank state.

methods.name: git_repository_reinit_filesystem
methods.description: Updates filesystem config settings for an open repository, especially after moving to a new filesystem.

methods.name: git_repository_set_config
methods.description: Associates a configuration object with the repository.

methods.name: git_repository_set_odb
methods.description: Sets the Object Database (ODB) for the repository.

methods.name: git_repository_set_refdb
methods.description: Sets the Reference Database backend for the repository.

methods.name: git_repository_set_index
methods.description: Sets the index file for the repository.

methods.name: git_repository_set_bare
methods.description: Configures the repository to be bare, without a working directory.
